en.Situation: In my first networking job, a new office area had no network because the switch port was never put on the correct VLAN.
en.Task: I was asked to fix it during the move-in morning, with staff already at their desks.
en.Action: I checked the port configuration against the site sheet, moved the port to the office VLAN, and confirmed the change with the mover's supervisor.
en.Result: The area was online by ten, and I updated the site sheet so the next move would not repeat it.
en.vague: A new area had no network and it needed sorting.
en.exaggerated: I designed the office network from scratch on my own.
en.no_data: After the change the area had network access.

zh.Situation: 第一份網絡工作，一個新辦公區冇網絡，因為 switch port 從來冇放喺正確 VLAN。
zh.Task: 要喺搬入當日朝早搞返好，而同事已經坐喺位。
zh.Action: 我對住 site sheet 檢查 port 設定，把 port 改去 office VLAN，再同搬遷主管確認。
zh.Result: 十點前該區上到網，我亦更新 site sheet 令下次搬遷唔會再犯。
zh.exaggerated: 我一個人由零設計咗成個辦公室網絡。

en.Situation: About twenty people working from home reported the VPN dropping every fifteen minutes, and the helpdesk had run out of ideas.
en.Task: I took the second-line ticket, and I had to find whether it was us, their home router, or the provider.
en.Action: I traced the tunnel logs, found one ISP path timing out, and ran a test with a colleague on the same ISP to confirm.
en.Result: It was the provider path, and after we reported it the drops stopped within two days.
en.vague: People working from home had connection problems.
en.exaggerated: I fixed the ISP's national network problem.
en.no_data: After we reported it, the drops stopped.

zh.Situation: 大約二十位在家工作同事報 VPN 每十五分鐘斷線，helpdesk 已經冇新想法。
zh.Task: 我接二線 ticket，要判斷係我哋、佢哋屋企 router，定係供應商問題。
zh.Action: 我追 tunnel log，發現有一條 ISP 路徑 timeout，再請同一個 ISP 嘅同事一齊測確認。
zh.Result: 係供應商路徑問題，我哋報上去之後兩日內斷線停止。
zh.vague: 在家工作同事有連線問題。
zh.exaggerated: 我修好咗 ISP 全港性網絡問題。

en.Situation: A business unit needed a firewall rule opened between two segments before a client demo on Friday.
en.Task: I was the engineer on the change, and I had to get it approved and tested in three days.
en.Action: I asked for the source, destination and port in writing, wrote the rule with the narrowest scope, and tested it on the lab copy first.
en.Result: The rule went live Thursday evening and the demo worked, and the narrow scope meant nothing else was exposed.
en.vague: A team needed a firewall change quickly.
en.exaggerated: I opened the network to make the client happy.
en.no_data: In the end the demo worked.

zh.Situation: 有個業務單位要喺星期五客戶 demo 前開一條 firewall 規則，打通兩個網段。
zh.Task: 我負責該改動，要三日內拿到批核同完成測試。
zh.Action: 我請對方書面提供來源、目的地同 port，寫成最窄範圍嘅規則，先喺 lab 副本測。
zh.Result: 規則星期四晚生效，demo 順利，因為範圍窄亦冇曝露其他嘢。
zh.exaggerated: 我開放咗網絡嚟令客戶滿意。

en.Situation: Four years in, a failover drill showed the standby database would take two hours to take over, not the thirty minutes we promised.
en.Task: I owned the drill result, and I had to report the real number and a plan rather than a target.
en.Action: I timed each stage of the switchover, found the log shipping was a day behind, and changed the interval with the database owner.
en.Result: The next drill took thirty-five minutes, and the fourth stage was still listed as the remaining risk.
en.vague: The failover drill showed some timing issues.
en.exaggerated: I built a fully resilient platform for the company.

zh.Situation: 做咗四年，一次 failover 演練顯示備用資料庫要兩小時才接上，而我哋承諾係三十分鐘。
zh.Task: 我負責演練結果，要報真實數字同計劃，而唔係報目標。
zh.Action: 我為切換每個階段計時，發現 log shipping 落後一日，於是同資料庫負責人改咗間隔。
zh.Result: 下次演練三十五分鐘，而第四個階段仍然列為剩餘風險。
zh.vague: failover 演練顯示有啲時間問題。
zh.exaggerated: 我為公司建立咗完全可靠嘅平台。

en.Situation: In my internship, the server room had unlabelled cables and a patch panel nobody could read.
en.Task: I was given two afternoons to make it traceable, with no budget for new hardware.
en.Action: I traced each cable with a tester, labelled both ends, and photographed the panel with a printed key.
en.Result: The next fault took ten minutes to locate instead of an hour, and the photo key stayed on the wall.
en.vague: The cabling was messy and hard to follow.
en.exaggerated: I rebuilt the entire server room infrastructure.
en.no_data: After labelling, finding a cable was easier.

zh.Situation: 實習時機房線纜冇標籤，patch panel 冇人睇得明。
zh.Task: 我只有兩個下午，要令佢追蹤得到，而冇錢買新硬件。
zh.Action: 我用 tester 逐條線追，兩端都貼標籤，再影相配一張列印索引貼牆。
zh.Result: 下次故障十分鐘內定位，而唔係一個鐘，相片索引一直貼住。
zh.exaggerated: 我重建咗整個機房基建。

en.Situation: We moved a file server between data stores and the application team found slow response on large reports afterwards.
en.Task: I had to check the storage path and explain the change to them, without rolling back blindly.
en.Action: I compared read latency before and after, found the new datastore was not the one on the fast tier, and asked for a move back on that one volume.
en.Result: Report time returned to the old figure within a day, and the other volumes stayed where they were.
en.vague: Reports were slow after a storage change.
en.exaggerated: I fixed the whole storage architecture in one request.
en.no_data: After the move back, the reports were fast again.

zh.Situation: 我哋把檔案伺服器搬去另一組 data store，之後應用團隊話大報表反應慢。
zh.Task: 我要檢查儲存路徑並向佢哋解釋，而唔係盲目 rollback。
zh.Action: 我比較改前改後讀取延遲，發現新 data store 唔喺快層，於是只要求搬返該一個 volume。
zh.Result: 一日內報表時間返到舊水平，其他 volume 維持原位。
zh.vague: 儲存改動之後報表變慢。
zh.exaggerated: 我一個要求就修好整個儲存架構。

en.Situation: Five years in, a vendor was due on site to replace a core switch and the branch could not lose the counter system for a whole day.
en.Task: I had to plan the window and get the branch manager to accept it in writing.
en.Action: I split the work into two evenings, wrote the sequence with a rollback step, and confirmed the counter close time with her.
en.Result: Both evenings finished inside the window, and the counter system was up before opening on both days.
en.exaggerated: I replaced the branch's core network single-handedly.
en.no_data: The replacement went out over two evenings.

zh.Situation: 做咗五年，vendor 要上門換核心 switch，而分店唔可以成日冇收銀系統。
zh.Task: 我要計劃時間窗，並要分店經理書面接受。
zh.Action: 我把工作拆成兩個晚上，寫明次序同 rollback 步驟，再同佢確認收銀關閉時間。
zh.Result: 兩個晚上都喺窗口內完成，兩日開門前收銀系統都已恢復。
zh.exaggerated: 我一個人換咗分店嘅核心網絡。

en.Situation: In my first role, the monitoring sent an alert every night at two because a backup job used all the disk for ten minutes.
en.Task: I was asked to stop the false alerts without turning off the disk alert entirely.
en.Action: I added a short suppression during the backup window and a separate threshold for that window, then watched it for a week.
en.Result: Night alerts stopped, and a real disk growth a month later still triggered at the new threshold.
en.vague: We got alerts at night that were not real problems.
en.exaggerated: I rebuilt the whole monitoring system.
en.no_data: After the change the night alerts stopped.

zh.Situation: 第一份工，監控每晚兩點都響，因為備份 job 會用盡磁碟十分鐘。
zh.Task: 我要停止假警報，但唔可以整個關掉磁碟警報。
zh.Action: 我喺備份時間窗加短暫抑制，並為該窗口設另一個門檻，再觀察一星期。
zh.Result: 夜間警報停咗，一個月後真正嘅磁碟增長仍然喺新門檻觸發。
zh.vague: 夜晚會有啲唔係真問題嘅警報。
zh.exaggerated: 我重建咗成個監控系統。
zh.no_data: 改完之後夜間警報停咗。

en.Situation: A branch office complained about slow file access, and the first answer from the business was to buy a new server.
en.Task: I had to check the actual cause before anyone spent that money.
en.Action: I measured latency from their desks, found the link was saturated at the start of the day, and proposed a local cache instead.
en.Result: The cache removed most of the delay, and the server purchase was not needed that year.
en.vague: The branch said file access was slow.
en.exaggerated: I saved the company a large hardware purchase.
en.no_data: After the cache the delay was much smaller.

zh.Situation: 一間分店投訴檔案存取慢，業務第一個答案係買新伺服器。
zh.Task: 我要喺有人花錢之前查真正原因。
zh.Action: 我喺佢哋座位量度延遲，發現條鏈路喺早上開工時飽和，於是建議本機 cache 代替。
zh.Result: cache 消除大部分延誤，該年唔需要買伺服器。
zh.exaggerated: 我幫公司慳咗一大筆硬件開支。
zh.no_data: 加 cache 之後延誤細咗好多。

en.Situation: Six years in, a patch window collided with month-end processing and the finance system had to be down for an hour.
en.Task: I had to move the window and prove the new time would not collide again.
en.Action: I listed every scheduled job in that hour, checked which ones touched the finance system, and proposed the fourth Tuesday instead.
en.Result: The next three months ran without a collision, and the job list is now part of the patch plan.
en.vague: The patch window clashed with month-end.
en.exaggerated: I ended all scheduling conflicts across the company.
en.no_data: After moving the window there were no more clashes.

zh.Situation: 做咗六年，patch window 撞正月結，財務系統要停一小時。
zh.Task: 我要改時間，並證明新時間唔會再撞。
zh.Action: 我列出該小時所有排程工作，查出邊啲會掂財務系統，再建議改去第四個星期二。
zh.Result: 之後三個月都冇再撞，而工作清單已納入 patch 計劃。
zh.exaggerated: 我終結咗公司所有排程衝突。

en.Situation: On a six-month contract, a user kept asking me to plug personal devices into the office network.
en.Task: I had to say no in a way that kept the working relationship.
en.Action: I explained the guest network option, set it up in five minutes, and told him what the office network was for.
en.Result: He used the guest network from then on, and he stopped asking other engineers.
en.vague: There was a request I could not approve.
en.exaggerated: I prevented a serious network security incident.
en.no_data: In the end he used the guest network.

zh.Situation: 做半年合約，有位同事不停叫我幫佢把私人裝置接入辦公室網絡。
zh.Task: 我要拒絕，但唔想破壞工作關係。
zh.Action: 我解釋有 guest network，五分鐘幫佢設定好，再講清楚辦公室網絡嘅用途。
zh.Result: 之後佢一直用 guest network，亦冇再問其他工程師。
zh.exaggerated: 我阻止咗一次嚴重網絡安全事故。

en.Situation: At a school group, the IT teacher and I disagreed about whether the slow login was the network or the ageing computers.
en.Task: We had to agree on a cause before the budget meeting, or the wrong thing would be replaced.
en.Action: We measured login time on the same computers before and after moving one lab to a separate segment.
en.Result: The measurement showed the network was the cause, and the segment change fixed the slow login for that lab.
en.vague: Login was slow and we were not sure why.
en.exaggerated: I proved the school's whole network was badly designed.
en.no_data: After the change login was faster.

zh.Situation: 喺學校集團，我同 IT 老師對「登入慢係網絡定老電腦」有分歧。
zh.Task: 預算會議前要議定原因，否則會換錯嘢。
zh.Action: 我哋用同一批電腦，量度其中一間 lab 搬去獨立網段前後嘅登入時間。
zh.Result: 量度顯示係網絡問題，該間 lab 改網段後登入變快。
zh.vague: 登入慢，我哋唔確定原因。
zh.exaggerated: 我證明咗學校成個網絡設計差。
